attchmntText: Wonder Electricals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Wonder Electricals Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Profit after tax was 56.54 lakh INR for the quarter and 460.20 lakh INR for the half-year. The Board placed the re-appointment of Mr. Ankit Tiwari as Non-Executive Independent Director and the appointment of Mr. Shobhit Batta and Mr. Abhijeet Kumar as Additional Non-Executive Independent Directors before shareholders for approval. These appointments are subject to shareholder approval. Mr. Rahul Prasad was appointed as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer with effect from November 12, 2026. The company partially redeemed 1,50,000 preference shares aggregating to 1,50,00,000 INR. The statutory auditors issued an unqualified opinion on the financial results.

attchmntText: Wonder Electricals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr VISHAL SINGH BHADAURIA  as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Wonder Electricals Limited intimates that Mr. Vishal Singh, DIN 07500944, Independent Director, has completed his tenure and ceased to be a Director on November 12, 2026. The cessation is due to tenure completion. No resignation letter is applicable. Mr. Singh holds directorships in Shri Gang Industries and Allied Products Limited. He is a member of the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, and Stakeholder Relationship Committee of Shri Gang Industries and Allied Products Limited.

attchmntText: Wonder Electricals Limited has informed the Exchange about Submission of Additional Details pursuant to Exchange Query regarding Resignation of Independent Director under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Wonder Electricals Limited submitted additional details regarding the resignation of Independent Director Ms. Bhawna Saunkhiya, DIN 10683032, effective 05.11.2026. The resignation is due to pre-occupation with other professional commitments. Ms. Saunkhiya confirmed there are no other material reasons for her departure. She was appointed on 12 November 2024. Her directorships include Technocraft Ventures Limited, KCK Industries Limited, Logic Infotech Limited, and N.E. Electronics Limited. She holds various committee positions in these entities, including Chairman of Audit Committees. The company filed this information pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations and a SEBI Circular dated January 30, 2026. The resignation letter is enclosed as Annexure B. This intimation is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Wonder Electricals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Ms Bhawna Saunkhiya as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 05, 2026.
